scope: D2Q9 template-generated BGK/TRT equivalence with an independent NumPy kernel and analytic periodic Taylor-Green decay. The declared divergence criterion failed in the historical audit. The selected anchor criteria and the full preregistered verdict are distinct.

criteria.convergence_rule: a family is treated as grid-converged when |nu(N=32) - nu(N=64)| / |nu(N=64)| < 10%; otherwise both values and the delta are reported as a resolution-sensitivity result

references.value: Taylor, G. I. (1923) 'On the decay of vortices in a viscous fluid', Phil. Mag. 46:671-674 (vortex decay rate exp(-2 nu k^2 t)); equilibrium/Chapman-Enskog form of the LBM viscosity nu=(tau-1/2)cs^2: Succi, 'The Lattice Boltzmann Equation' (2001) ch.5; Kruger et al., 'The Lattice Boltzmann Method: Principles and Practice' (2017) sec. 5.2 & 9.1; TRT/magic parameter: Ginzburg, Verhaeghe & d'Humieres (2008) Commun. Comput. Phys. 3:427-478
